annotations.title: Create a Stellar wallet funding order

description: Turn an approved quote into a payable order. Returns fundingId (keep it private: it is the only handle to the order), the one-time deposit address, the suggested amount and amountPolicy with minAcceptedAmount/maxPricedAmount when any_amount, payBefore and the accepted chains and tokens. orderId is your own reference: the server derives the upstream order id and Idempotency-Key from quoteId plus orderId, so it only has to be unique among your own orders. Retrying with the same quoteId and orderId returns the same order instead of a second one. Creates an order but moves no funds; an unpaid order expires at no cost. Fees come from the quote (fees and totals): never assume a fee. The receiving Stellar address signs ONE transaction (only when it is new or has no USDC trustline). The one-time deposit address is the same on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Polygon; USDC or USDT is accepted 1:1. Follow deposit.amountPolicy: exact or missing means pay the EXACT deposit amount; any_amount uses the suggested amount and returned min/max bounds. Pay once, before payBefore. This server never holds keys: your own wallet pays and signs.

orderId.description: Your own order reference, 8 to 128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -, unique among your orders (for example agent-order-0001). Reuse it with the same quoteId to retry safely.
